newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia to issue CPs to fund wheat sowings.
newsitem.headline: Serbia to issue CPs to fund wheat sowings.

text.p: Serbia will launch a series of debt issues to finance various money-starved segments of industry, a senior government official said this weekend.

"Serbia will issue short- and long-term commercial papers to provide fresh funds for its cash-starved economy, starting with upcoming wheat sowing," Dusan Vlatkovic, Serbia's Finance Minister, told reporters at the end of a symposium held in this Montenegrin seaside resort.
"The government is also considering whether to issue commercial papers to cover its budget deficit and long-term investments primarily in infrastructure," he said.
"Issuing long-term commercial papers will be the way to attract fresh domestic and foreign funds," Vlatkovic said.

According to Vlatkovic, the republic's government will issue commercial papers to finance this year's wheat sowing on up to 800,000 hectares expected to yield between 1.2 - 1.4 milion tonnes of wheat.
"This will be a noninflatory way to finance the sowing," he said, adding that the commercial papers will be backed with wheat.
"Considering increased demand for wheat on the world market, the government is also considering available models for advanced financing of the wheat production to boost exports," Vlatkovic said.
This spring the Serbian government issued commercial papers backed by wheat to finance spring sowing for about 130,000 tonnes of wheat.
This year's record low harvest forced the government to increase the acreage.
One of the dealers at the Belgrade bourse said the Serbian government could finance the entire agricultural sector by issuing commercial papers. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
